topPRs.title: chore(op-reth): introduce factory pattern for OpProofsStore
topPRs.author: dhyaniarun1993
topPRs.body:
**Description**

Refactors the OpProofsStore trait from a flat interface (where read, write, and init operations were all methods on the store itself) into a factory pattern with distinct transactional providers:

- OpProofsStore — factory only; provides provider_ro(), provider_rw(), initialization_provider()
- OpProofsProviderRO — read-only provider: cursor access, get_earliest/latest_block_number, fetch_trie_updates
- OpProofsProviderRw: OpProofsProviderRO — write provider: store_trie_updates, prune_earliest_state, replace_updates, unwind_history, set_earliest_block_number, commit(self)
- OpProofsInitProvider — initialization-only provider: bulk insertion of initial trie/account/storage state, committed via commit(self)

This mirrors the pattern used in reth's database layer where the store is a handle that creates short-lived transactional providers rather than exposing database methods directly.

**Motivation**

The flat API made it impossible to enforce transaction boundaries — callers could interleave reads and writes with no clear commit point. By separating concerns into typed providers, each transaction has an explicit lifetime and commit() is always intentional.

**Tests**

- [x] e2e tests

**Additional context**

This PR prepares the database layer for `memory overlay + async batch writes` improvements

**Metadata**

NA

topPRs.title: feat: zk opcm go
topPRs.author: ashitakah
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Wires `ZK_DISPUTE_GAME` into the Go deployer upgrade path, enabling `op-deployer` to encode and pass ZK game configurations to `OPContractsManagerV2` during chain upgrades.

---

## Changes

### `upgrade/embedded/upgrade.go`

- Added `GameTypeZKDisputeGame = 10` constant
- Added `ZKDisputeGameConfig` struct with all 5 fields (`absolutePrestate`, `verifier`, `maxChallengeDuration`, `maxProveDuration`, `challengerBond`)
- Added `zkEncoder` with the ABI signature matching the Solidity struct
- Added case `GameTypeZKDisputeGame` in `EncodedUpgradeInputV2` with nil config validation and error propagation

### `upgrade/embedded/upgrade_test.go`

- Exact ABI hex encoding verification for a ZK game config
- Validation test: enabled ZK game with nil `ZKDisputeGameConfig` returns error
- Disabled ZK game encodes correctly with empty `gameArgs`

---

## Pipeline / Addresses

- **`devfeatures.go`** — added `SuperRootGamesMigrationDevFlag` constant
- **`opcm/implementations.go`, `opcm/opchain.go`, `pipeline/implementations.go`, `pipeline/opchain.go`** — wired `zkDisputeGameImpl` address through the pipeline structs
- **`op-chain-ops/addresses/contracts.go`, `interopgen/deployments.go`** — registered ZK impl in the shared contract address maps
- **`ReadImplementationAddresses.s.sol`** — reads `zkDisputeGameImpl` from the OPCM container when V2 flag is active

topPRs.title: refactor(contracts): remove OPCMv1 from all Solidity code
topPRs.author: smartcontracts
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Remove OPContractsManager v1 from all Solidity code, making OPContractsManagerV2 the sole OPCM.

- **Delete v1 contract**: `OPContractsManager.sol` (2203 lines, 7 inner contracts) and gut `IOPContractsManager.sol` interface
- **Remove v1 gating**: `DevFeatures.OPCM_V2` flag, `Constants.OPCM_V2_MIN_VERSION`, `Config.devFeatureOpcmV2()`
- **Delete v1-only files**: `AddGameType.s.sol`, `opcm-upgrade-checks/` directory, 3 test files, 12 snapshot files
- **Update deploy scripts**: All 10 deploy scripts now unconditionally use V2 types (no more v1/v2 branching)
- **Update test infrastructure**: ~17 test/setup files cleaned of v1 branches, assertions, and imports

V2 contracts in `src/L1/opcm/` are completely untouched — they have zero V1 dependencies.

**56 files changed, +212 / -13,404 lines** (net deletion of ~13,200 lines)

This is PR 1 of the OPCMv1 removal series. Breaks out the Solidity-side changes from #19385. Go code (`op-deployer`) and CI matrix changes follow in subsequent PRs.

## Test plan

- [x] `mise exec -- just build-dev` passes (zero compilation errors)
- [x] `mise exec -- just pr` passes (17/17 checks: lint, semgrep, snapshots, semver-diff, interfaces, size-check, etc.)
- [x] Zero remaining imports of `IOPContractsManager` or `OPContractsManager` (non-V2)
- [x] Zero remaining references to `DevFeatures.OPCM_V2` or `Constants.OPCM_V2_MIN_VERSION`
- [x] Zero remaining `isOPCMv2` / `isOPCMV2` variables
- [x] V2 contracts in `src/L1/opcm/` verified untouched
- [ ] CI passes (pending)
- [ ] `mise exec -- just test-dev` passes (not yet run — long-running)

topPRs.title: exp: move packages/contracts-bedrock to op-contracts at repo root
topPRs.author: smartcontracts
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Experimental branch that moves `packages/contracts-bedrock/` to `op-contracts/` at the repository root. This is a structural refactor experiment to reveal the end-to-end complexity of relocating the contracts package.

## What Changed

- **958 files changed** (mostly renames), **556 lines modified** across ~110 non-contract files
- Directory moved: `packages/contracts-bedrock/` -> `op-contracts/`
- All path references updated across Go, CI, Docker, docs, scripts, and config files
- Git submodules (11 forge dependencies) properly relocated
- `.gitmodules` updated with new submodule paths

### Files/areas updated:
- **Go import paths**: All `github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/packages/contracts-bedrock/...` -> `github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/op-contracts/...` (op-challenger, op-proposer, op-node, op-deployer, op-devstack, op-dispute-mon, op-e2e, op-service, cannon)
- **CI**: `.circleci/continue/main.yml` working directories and change detection patterns
- **Docker**: `docker-bake.hcl`, `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore`
- **Justfiles**: Root, cannon, op-deployer, op-e2e, op-fetcher, op-acceptance-tests, rust/op-reth
- **Foundry config**: `op-service/gnosis/contracts/foundry.toml` remappings
- **Script relative paths**: `../../` -> `../` where directory depth changed
- **CODEOWNERS**: Path patterns updated
- **Docs**: ~50 documentation files with path references
- **Semgrep rules**: Path patterns in `.semgrep/rules/`
- **Codecov**: `codecov.yml` path patterns

## Build Verification

| Check | Status |
|-------|--------|
| `forge build` (op-contracts) | PASS |
| `go build ./op-contracts/...` | PASS |
| `go build ./op-challenger/...` | PASS |
| `go build ./op-node/...` | PASS |
| `go build ./op-proposer/...` | PASS |
| `go build ./op-deployer/...` | PASS |
| `go build ./op-devstack/...` | PASS |
| `go build ./cannon/...` | PASS |
| `go build ./op-service/...` | PASS |
| `go build ./op-dispute-mon/...` | PASS |
| `go build ./...` (full repo) | PASS |

## Decisions Made

1. **CI job names left as-is**: Job names like `contracts-bedrock-build` and `contracts-bedrock-tests` were NOT renamed. They're internal identifiers that don't need to match directory paths, and renaming them would break cross-references in CI config.
2. **branches.yaml not updated**: `.github/workflows/branches.yaml` is push-protected and cannot be modified without admin override. It still references `packages/contracts-bedrock` in its path triggers.
3. **Submodule names updated**: The `.gitmodules` submodule names and paths were both updated to `op-contracts/lib/*`.

## Complexity Report

**Difficulty: Medium** -- The move itself is straightforward, but the blast radius is significant.

### What was surprising:
- **543 occurrences across 124 files** referenced the old path
- **Git submodules** (11 forge dependencies) required careful handling with `git mv`. Normal `git mv` works but the submodule config needs manual attention
- **Relative path depth changes**: Scripts inside the package used `../../` to reach the repo root (since they were 2 levels deep in `packages/contracts-bedrock/`). Moving to `op-contracts/` (1 level deep) means all these become `../`
- **Push protection**: GitHub's push protection blocked modification of `.github/workflows/branches.yaml`, requiring an admin process
- **No Go module changes needed**: The Go module path (`github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism`) doesn't change -- only internal import paths within the module

### What went smoothly:
- Forge build worked immediately after the move
- Go builds all pass with just the import path changes
- The foundry.toml config uses relative paths internally (src, libs, etc.) so no changes needed there

## Side Effects

- `packages/` directory is now empty and removed
- `.github/workflows/branches.yaml` still references old path (push-protected)
- CI cache keys reference `contracts-bedrock` in their names (cosmetic, no functional impact)

## Not Tested

- Full `just pr` suite (requires forge test + all checks)
- CI end-to-end (would need the branches.yaml update)
- Forge tests (time-consuming, not attempted in this experiment)
- Kontrol proofs (script path assumptions may need verification)

---

*This is an experiment to reveal complexity. Not intended for merge.*
